name: message_fix
description: Surgically fix specific validation issues while preserving message intent and voice
content:
Fix the specific issues in this {message_type} message.

## ORIGINAL MESSAGE
{message}

## ISSUES TO FIX
{issues_text}

## SENDER'S VOICE
{voice_block}
{voice_rules}

## CONSTRAINTS
- MAXIMUM {max_chars} characters (hard limit)
- Fix ONLY the listed issues
- Preserve everything else — same prospect details, same CTA, same tone
- Must still sound like the sender wrote it

## OUTPUT
Write ONLY the fixed message text. Nothing else.
